messages:
lucas: Quick pulse — kernel PR #492 is blocked on eng-infra change for pinned CUDA driver. Anyone on infra able to confirm ETA? Losing canary window tomorrow.
anya: I'm checking with infra, pinging @max. Can you post a short repro / failing CI logs?
lucas: CI failing on warmup e2e: `RuntimeError: Cuda driver mismatch`. Short trace: `load_kernel() -> init_device() -> driver_version()` — reproducible on our canary image.
max: infra says the host image update is scheduled EOD. If we need earlier we can cut a hotfix image but it'll require a quick validation run. What's the risk if canary delayed 24h? :thinking: 
sam: Canary contains continuous-batching changes + KV warmup heuristics. If delayed 24h we can route low-traffic to the older kernel, but cost/perf regression checks will slip. I'd prefer EOD update so we don't stall the sprint roll.
anya: Ownership question — who will own the hotfix build + smoke tests? Also small ask: @sam please review the kernel PR, it's one liner in kernel init.
lucas: I can own the hotfix image and coord tests. I'll draft PR and tag QA. Sam — can you do a quick pass on the batching perf test harness once I have the image?
sam: On it. I have a free slot at 15:00 PT, will run the harness against the hotfix image and post results here.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: image-build triggered by lucas/hotfix-kernel (build 873) — build passed unit checks and container scan. Notifying @max for rollout validation.
max: :thumbsup: I'll validate the host image rollout window and check canary scheduling. @lucas please add kernel test log and CI diff to PR description.
lucas: Will do. FYI KV-cache metric: cold-start median improved but saw a production spike at 01:30 with higher p99; logging that in the ticket for followup. Quick Q for gating: do we want to gate canary on p99 latency + no error regressions, or p95?
anya: Gate on p99 + zero error regressions for this one — it's a kernel/driver change that can affect tails. Update the canary checklist accordingly.
sam: SGTM. I'll add a narrow load profile to the harness to exercise p99 tail and include the results in the PR comment.
lucas: Thanks — starting hotfix PR now, will ping when build/artifacts are uploaded and smoke tests finish. :thumbsup:
